introduction: A great movieMala leche, is a refresh for the Latin American cinema, it's a realistic andcaptivating feature. It is and amazing movie that shows a latinamerican reality with a lot of style. It's a brutal tale of friendship, love and crime. It's full of vitality and action filmed with much quality. It's the story of two young criminals who make and unsuccessful debut in the world of drug dealing. with the threat that they must repay the money lost in the transaction in two days or die, the two set out on a frantic wave of crime.It's a great represented of the new latinamerican cinema, like "Cidade de deus" (brazil), "Amores perros¨(Mexico) and "Y tu mamá también", (mexico) I recommend it very muchmatias jarpa from Santiago, Chile
